subject: Re: Quick follow-up & pricing details — Startup Program + Commitments
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana@atlasai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0000
Subject: Quick recap + next steps (pricing & commitment options)

Hi Sana — great to meet you and the AtlasAI team today. Short recap and next steps from our call: 

- Usage profile & goal: you mentioned the initial production workload will be ~1M tokens/day (avg) with spikes to ~3M; early-month batch processing for training/evals could add ~10M tokens/month. Expected steady-state: ~30–35M tokens/month in Q2 after ramp.
- Primary constraint: tight budget in H1; target unit economics around $X / 1M tokens (we scoped a target ~ $800–$1,200 per 1M tokens depending on latency/quantization choices).
- Technical needs: low-latency chat (sub-300ms for short requests), KV cache sharing across sessions (Aditya will follow up on cache config).

Attachments: I've included a simple usage estimate (usage-estimate-1Mtokens.xlsx) and our pricing grid (redwood-pricing-grid.pdf). Also attached a draft Startup Program term sheet (RNW-Startup-Program-Termsheet.pdf) that outlines the 6-month introductory credit + committed-use uplift options.

Discount & committed-use options we discussed (high-level):
- Startup Program: 6 months 50% usage credit up to $30k + onboarding credits (requires company stage verification).
- Committed use (12-mo): 10% discount on list rates for a 12-mo, 1x committed baseline (example: commit 360M tokens/year = 30M tokens/mo).
- Committed use (24-mo): 18% discount + additional pricing floors for multi-year financials.
- Multi-tier example unit economics: 1M tokens @ list = $2,200 / 1M (example); with 18% multi-year incentive => ~$1,804 / 1M. We can build a model specific to your mix (chat vs batch, quantization, and SLOs).

Next steps: 
1) Can you confirm an expected monthly token target (conservative, expected, peak) for the next 12 months so we can model committed tiers?
2) Let me know if you qualify for the Startup Program (YC/seed-stage, funding docs). I can route the application.
3) I'll draft two pricing scenarios (12-mo commit and 24-mo commit) + a startup + 12-mo combo and send the cost per 1M tokens and total annual spend.

I'll follow up once Aditya sends the technical plan for caching.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0134

Redwood Inference — inference that scales

---

From: Sana Patel <sana@atlasai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps (pricing & commitment options)

Thanks Marissa — this is super helpful. A few clarifications from my side: 

- For modeling: conservative = 20M tokens/mo, expected = 35M tokens/mo, peak = 60M tokens/mo. The heavy batch processing (10–15M/mo) is mostly in Jan/Feb for retraining.
- Budget: our procurement deck has $250k allocated for inference in H1, but we can stretch to $600k if unit economics hit the right mark.
- We are early-stage (Series A, lead investor disclosed) — looks like we should qualify for the Startup Program? I can share funding docs.

Can you send an example price sheet showing target $/1M tokens for the 12- and 24-month commit bands and a blended example for expected usage? Also curious on any additional onboarding credits or pilot credits you can offer.

Sana
Head of Product, AtlasAI
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana@atlasai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps (pricing & commitment options)

Hi Sana — thanks for the numbers, that's exactly what we need. Attached is a short pricing scenarios sheet (redwood-pricing-grid.pdf) and a modeled example below — I'll also send the formal term sheet if you want to proceed after reviewing.

Modeled scenarios (blended economics, illustrative):

1) No commit (Pay-as-you-go):
   - List: $2,200 / 1M tokens (baseline for high-availability, low-latency chat)
   - For expected 35M tokens/mo => ~35 * $2,200 = $77,000 / month (~$924k / year).

2) 12-month commit (10% off list) — conservative commit 20M/mo baseline + burst: 
   - Effective: $1,980 / 1M tokens (10% off)
   - For expected 35M tokens/mo => ~35 * $1,980 = $69,300 / month (~$831.6k / year).

3) 24-month commit (18% off list) — recommended for multi-year savings: 
   - Effective: $1,804 / 1M tokens (18% off)
   - For expected 35M tokens/mo => ~35 * $1,804 = $63,140 / month (~$757.7k / year).

4) Startup Program (one-time onboarding + credits):
   - 6 months of 50% usage credit up to $30k + 1 month free onboarding credits. This materially reduces cash outlay in Q1 but does not replace committed discounts.

Combo example (Startup + 12-mo): Startup credits applied to first 3 months usage + 12-mo 10% discount after credits — net cash in Year 1 depends on how quickly you ramp; we can run a blended cash flow.

Examples for your stated budget: 
- If you need to stay <= $600k/year, the 24-mo commit gets you closest; we can also build a hybrid where you commit a 20M/mo baseline (12-mo) and cover bursts at PAYG to hit $600k target. I'll model the hybrid with your exact mix and share today EOD.

Onboarding credits: for Series A startups on our program we typically provide an additional $10k onboarding credit for a 12-mo commitment (applies to professional services/priority onboarding).

Action items:
- Sana: please share Series A funding verification and procurement contact for AtlasAI.
- Aditya/Marissa: we'll prepare the detailed cost model for (conservative/expected/peak), and a draft term sheet for 12- and 24-month options.

For transparency — I've looped Laura (sales manager) to expedite approvals for a Startup Program exception if needed.

Best,
Marissa

---

Sana
